text: great next a model import may have a texture in the model file for applicable models, but we never set it, change that and always add this texture as a paint variant
resolution: Compatible self-contained GLB imports now adopt their embedded base-colour image and original TEXCOORD_0 mapping as the live paint atlas. The importer fails closed for mixed or unsupported material contracts, guards image dimensions before decode, applies the shared base-colour factor, and publishes the final UV-correct resident mesh. The editor skips the fallback colour flood, writes a new import as the package base, and automatically stores a fingerprint-deduplicated Imported Texture full-look variant while preserving any existing authored base; editing that variant removes its pristine-source provenance so it can be recaptured later. Added GLB extraction/compatibility/data-URI tests, painter limit coverage, paint-variant dedupe/recapture coverage, documentation, and verified the ReleaseFast editor build.
